title: Dhuhr prayer
intro: The second daily prayer: 4 sunnah, 4 fard and 2 sunnah – 10 rak‘ahs.

learn.html: Dhuhr is the second daily prayer. Its time begins when the sun has passed the middle of the sky. It has 10 rak‘ahs: four sunnah, four fard and two sunnah. We pray the sunnah first, then the fard, then the last sunnah.

learn.label: Niyyah for the sunnah of Dhuhr
learn.ar: نَوَيْتُ أَنْ أُصَلِّيَ لِلَّهِ تَعَالَى صَلَاةَ سُنَّةِ الظُّهْرِ أَدَاءً مُسْتَقْبِلَ الْقِبْلَةِ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
learn.tr: Nawaytu an usalliya lillaahi ta‘aalaa salaata sunnatidh-dhuhri, adaa’an mustaqbilal-qiblati. Allaahu akbar!
learn.en: I intend to pray, for Allah, the sunnah of Dhuhr, on time, facing the Qiblah. Allah is the Greatest!

items: 1st rak‘ah: Subhanaka, A‘udhu, Bismillah, Al-Fatiha and a surah
2nd rak‘ah: Bismillah, Al-Fatiha and a surah
3rd rak‘ah: Bismillah, Al-Fatiha and a surah
4th rak‘ah: Bismillah, Al-Fatiha and a surah
Last sitting: At-Tahiyyat, salawat, duas and salam

learn.label: Niyyah for the fard of Dhuhr
learn.ar: نَوَيْتُ أَنْ أُصَلِّيَ لِلَّهِ تَعَالَى صَلَاةَ فَرْضِ الظُّهْرِ أَدَاءً مُسْتَقْبِلَ الْقِبْلَةِ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
learn.tr: Nawaytu an usalliya lillaahi ta‘aalaa salaata fardidh-dhuhri, adaa’an mustaqbilal-qiblati. Allaahu akbar!
learn.en: I intend to pray, for Allah, the fard of Dhuhr, on time, facing the Qiblah. Allah is the Greatest!

items: 1st rak‘ah: Subhanaka, A‘udhu, Bismillah, Al-Fatiha and a surah
2nd rak‘ah: Bismillah, Al-Fatiha and a surah
Last sitting: At-Tahiyyat, salawat, duas and salam
